description: Source code for tracing and performance measurement in a Git-related project, including functions for logging, timing, and repository setup.

methods.name: get_trace_fd
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the trace file descriptor based on environment variable or override.

methods.name: trace_override_envvar
methods.description: Overrides the environment variable for tracing with a specific value.

methods.name: trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing for a given trace key.

methods.name: prepare_trace_line
methods.description: Prepares a trace line with timestamp, file, and line info.

methods.name: trace_write
methods.description: Writes trace data to the trace file descriptor.

methods.name: trace_verbatim
methods.description: Logs raw data verbatim if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: print_trace_line
methods.description: Outputs a complete trace line.

methods.name: trace_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with file and line info.

methods.name: trace_argv_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Formats and outputs a trace message with argument vector.

methods.name: trace_strbuf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a trace message from a strbuf.

methods.name: trace_performance_enter
methods.description: Marks the start of a performance measurement.

methods.name: trace_performance_vprintf_fl
methods.description: Outputs a performance trace message.

methods.name: trace_printf_key_fl
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with a specific trace key.

methods.name: trace_argv_printf_fl
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with argument vector.

methods.name: trace_performance_fl
methods.description: Logs performance timing with optional message.

methods.name: trace_performance_leave_fl
methods.description: Marks the end of a performance measurement.

methods.name: quote_crnl
methods.description: Escapes special characters in file paths for logging.

methods.name: trace_repo_setup
methods.description: Logs repository setup details.

methods.name: trace_want
methods.description: Checks if tracing is enabled for a given key.

methods.name: highres_nanos
methods.description: Returns high-resolution nanoseconds timestamp.

methods.name: gettimeofday_nanos
methods.description: Returns nanoseconds since epoch using gettimeofday.

methods.name: getnanotime
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds with high resolution fallback.

methods.name: print_command_performance_atexit
methods.description: Outputs command performance data at program exit.

methods.name: trace_command_performance
methods.description: Starts performance measurement for a command.
